name: changelog-list
title: Changelog list
description: Four latest releases on a horizontal timeline with dates, versions and tags, earlier releases in a compact list below.
author: themes.dev

files.content:
import { ArrowRight, ArrowUpRight, Rss } from "lucide-react" import { cn } from "@/lib/utils" import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge" export type LinkRef = { label: string; href: string } /** Any short label; "New" is filled, every other tag outlined. */ export type ChangeTag = "New" | "Improved" | "Fixed" | (string & {}) export type Release = { version: string /** ISO date, shown as "18 Nov 2026". */ date: string title: string summary: string tag: ChangeTag href: string } export type ChangelogListProps = { title: string body: string all: LinkRef feed: LinkRef /** Newest first. The first four sit on the timeline, the rest in the list below it. */ releases: Release[] earlierLabel: string } export const changelogListDefaults: ChangelogListProps = { title: "Changelog", body: "What we shipped in Onwatch, the on-call rota and paging tool for 1,900 engineering teams. New releases every other Tuesday.", all: { label: "View all 112 releases", href: "/changelog" }, feed: { label: "RSS", href: "/changelog/rss.xml" }, releases: [ { version: "4.12", date: "2026-11-17", title: "Follow-the-sun rotas", summary: "Hand the pager from Amsterdam to Austin to Singapore on working hours. Onwatch works out the overlaps and warns you about gaps before they happen.", tag: "New", href: "/changelog/4-12", }, { version: "4.11", date: "2026-11-03", title: "Swap a shift from Slack", summary: "Type /onwatch swap, pick a colleague and a date. They accept in one click and the rota, calendar feeds and escalations update at once.", tag: "New", href: "/changelog/4-11", }, { version: "4.10.2", date: "2026-10-27", title: "Quieter alert grouping", summary: "Alerts from the same service within five minutes now arrive as one page. Teams in the beta were woken 38% less often at night.", tag: "Improved", href: "/changelog/4-10-2", }, { version: "4.10.1", date: "2026-10-21", title: "Phone calls in Portuguese and Polish", summary: "Voice escalations read the alert in the responder's own language. Onwatch now speaks fourteen, with a slower reading speed to choose from.", tag: "Improved", href: "/changelog/4-10-1", }, { version: "4.10", date: "2026-10-13", title: "Incident timelines you can export to PDF", summary: "", tag: "New", href: "/changelog/4-10" }, { version: "4.9.3", date: "2026-10-06", title: "Overrides no longer drop on daylight-saving changes", summary: "", tag: "Fixed", href: "/changelog/4-9-3" }, { version: "4.9.2", date: "2026-09-29", title: "Status page posts can be scheduled", summary: "", tag: "Improved", href: "/changelog/4-9-2" }, { version: "4.9.1", date: "2026-09-22", title: "Escalation retries respect quiet hours", summary: "", tag: "Fixed", href: "/changelog/4-9-1" }, { version: "4.9", date: "2026-09-15", title: "Rota fairness report per quarter", summary: "", tag: "New", href: "/changelog/4-9" }, ], earlierLabel: "Earlier releases", } const months = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"] const formatDate = (iso: string) => { const [y, m, d] = iso.split("-").map(Number) return `${d} ${months[m - 1]} ${y}` } function Tag({ tag }: { tag: ChangeTag }) { return ( {tag} ) } export function ChangelogList(props: Partial) { const c = { ...changelogListDefaults, ...props } const latest = c.releases.slice(0, 4) const earlier = c.releases.slice(4) return (

{c.title}

{c.body}

{c.all.label} {c.feed.label}
    {latest.map((r, i) => (

  1. {formatDate(r.date)} · Version v{r.version}

    {r.title}

    {r.summary}

    2. ))}
{earlier.length > 0 && (

{c.earlierLabel}

    {earlier.map((r) => (
  • {formatDate(r.date)} v{r.version} {r.title}
    • ))}
)}
) }
